author: Speeded
body:
Got bored so i made some Team Logos for all the registered teams in the upcoming
Battle For Eternity TDM Major.

https://imgur.com/a/fQcBC

*Most of these aren't really original/made by me, just took them off of google images and edited them.
(Included Apollo's Logo in the album cuz i wanted it to be there since they're also registered)
